subject.title: Subagent sessions persist after completion, main session becomes unresponsive

question: Should completed mode="run" subagent sessions default to retained history, hidden/archived history, or deletion after final delivery according to archiveAfterMinutes?
rationale: Current source and docs disagree, and each direction changes user-visible history, attachment retention, Control UI status, task reconciliation, and recovery behavior.

options.title: Retain but hide/archive by default
options.body: Keep completed one-shot history inspectable while excluding terminal child rows from active/default session and status views after final delivery settles.

options.title: Delete after final delivery or TTL
options.body: Make run-mode subagent cleanup remove child session rows according to archiveAfterMinutes, accepting reduced default history retention.

options.title: Keep current retention contract
options.body: Document cleanup=keep as preserving completed rows and limit the code change to status honesty, manual maintenance, and clearer filtering.

recommendation.title: Retain but hide/archive by default
recommendation.body: Keep completed one-shot history inspectable while excluding terminal child rows from active/default session and status views after final delivery settles.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session lifecycle, session-utils, gateway protocol, and Control UI work makes steipete the strongest available owner for the retention/UI product decision.
